rules.label: Chronic immunosuppressants
rules.rationale: Chronic immunosuppressive therapy is prohibited throughout treatment. Immunosuppression opposes the mechanism of checkpoint blockade and may mask immune-related adverse events.

rules.label: Systemic corticosteroids above 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent
rules.rationale: Corticosteroids above the stated threshold are prohibited. Physiologic replacement doses and short courses for non-oncologic indications may be permitted after discussion with the medical monitor.

rules.label: Live attenuated vaccines
rules.rationale: Live attenuated vaccines are prohibited within 4 weeks before the first dose and throughout treatment. Inactivated and recombinant vaccines are permitted.
rules.threshold: Within 28 days of first dose and throughout treatment

rules.label: Other systemic anticancer therapy
rules.rationale: No other systemic anticancer therapy may be given while the participant is on study treatment.
